newsitem.title: USA: Itochu takes 9.3 pct stake in ATS.
newsitem.headline: Itochu takes 9.3 pct stake in ATS.

text.p: ATS Medical Inc said Monday Itochu Corp of Japan has purchased about 1.6 million of its common shares or about 9.3 percent of its outstanding stock through an investment of nearly $15 million.
Itochu bought 1,568,940 ATS common shares at $9.40 each.
ATS said the funds will be used to increase the company's working capital and to help it pursue its strategic plan of expanding approval and use of its heart valve.
Itochu is the parent company of Century Medical Inc, ATS' distributor in Japan. ATS' heart valve was approved for marketing in Japan in July, 1996.

"This investment shows the confidence that Century Medical and Itochu have in our being able to become the primary valve in the Japanese market and it will strengthen the long-term relationship that ATS has with them," said Manny Villafana, ATS chairman and chief executive officer, in a statement.
